name: OPSD-NL
notes: ENTSO-E NL system load (OPSD time_series 60min, NL_load_actual_entsoe_transparency) + ERA5 weather (Open-Meteo). aux column holds the TSO's own published day-ahead load forecast (NL_load_forecast_entsoe_transparency, coverage 100.0%). exogenous-series rules: (1) a solar/wind series is dropped if its raw data has any single internal gap longer than 720 h (30 d); (2) then dropped if <50% present over the load span (v1). generation columns kept: {'wind': 'NL_wind_onshore_generation_actual (max internal gap 49 h)'}. dropped: [solar=NL_solar_generation_actual (internal gap of 2904 h > 720 h)]. missing cells interpolated: 174 (per channel {'wind': 174}; linear up to 6 h, then ffill/bfill).
